criteria.name: Problem 3a (award 2)
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 3a (award 2) (2 pts). Statement: 3a. Two unit circles and a circle of radius 2 3 are mutually externally tangent. Compute all possible values of r such that a circle of radius r is tangent to all three circles.

criteria.name: Problem 3b (award 2)
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 3b (award 2) (3 pts). Statement: 3b. Given three mutually tangent circles with curvatures a,b,c> 0, suppose that (a,b,c, 0) does not satisfy Descartes’ Circle Formula. Show that there are two distinct values of r such that there is a circle of radius r tangent to the given circles.

criteria.name: Problem 4a
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 4a (2 pts). Statement: 4. Find a geometric interpretation for this situation.

criteria.name: Problem 7
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 7 (3 pts). Statement: 7. Prove that the curvature of each circular plot is an integer.

criteria.name: Problem 9a
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 9a (2 pts). Statement: 9. Let P and Q be two proper c-triangles such that P dominates Q. Let C(P ) = (a,b,c,d ) and C(Q) = (w,x,y,z ). a. Show that P (3) dominates P (2) and that P (2) dominates P (1).

criteria.name: Problem 9c
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 9c (2 pts). Statement: c. Prove that P (3) dominates Q(3).

criteria.name: Problem 10a
